_comment: Batch 01 playable content. All base values, timers, thresholds, prices, loot weights and later-floor scaling are replaceable DEVELOPMENT tuning; not final balance. No set bonuses.

inventory._comment: Standard: 27 backpack cells, 9 equipment cells, 12 separate accessory slots.

statuses.name: Barrier
statuses.description: Absorbs incoming damage. Does not regenerate.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.description: Each independent layer deals snapshot fire damage every second.

statuses.name: Cold
statuses.description: Movement speed -25%; sources keep separate timers, only the strongest slow applies.

statuses.name: Backup Barrier
statuses.description: Snapshot shield equal to 40% maximum health; does not regenerate.

statuses.name: Emergency Shield
statuses.description: Absorbs damage equal to 50% of maximum health.

statuses.name: Arrival Tempo 20
statuses.description: Attack speed +20% until leaving the room.

statuses.name: Arrival Tempo 15
statuses.description: Attack speed +15% until leaving the room.

items.name: Cleansing Token
items.description: Removes the team curse when used.

items.name: Support Beacon
items.description: Select an unfinished battle room outside combat, then use to provide rapid support.

items.name: Oscillating Blade
items.description: Releases a short, piercing blade wave.

items.name: Tracking Marker
items.description: Tracks nearby valid targets with a limited turning rate.

items.name: Dual-Channel Coupler
items.description: One hit deals magic and fire segments with a shared critical roll.
items.lore: In the maintenance log, both ends always share one serial number.

items.name: Rare drain charm
items.description: Attack damage restores 3% of actual health lost. Development rarity placeholder.

items.name: Remington Model 700
items.description: A powerful, long-range single shot with a slow cadence.

items.name: Sealed Injector
items.description: Rapid chemical droplets at short to medium range.

items.name: Thermal Emitter
items.description: Applies Burning on hit; each layer has its own timer.

items.name: Condensing Projector
items.description: Applies a refreshing, non-stacking cold slow on hit.

items.name: Grip Ring
items.lore: The inside bears the impression of a different grip.

items.name: Note Clip
items.lore: An undated shopping list is tucked behind it.

items.name: Folding First-Aid Kit
items.description: Fixed and periodic healing received +20%; excludes lifesteal, rescue and resurrection.

items.name: Stress Bypass
items.description: After starting a dodge, weapon attack damage +40% for 4s (action group).

items.name: Fixed-Focus Lens
items.description: If the target is at full health before the hit, hit damage +50% (target state).

items.name: Feedback Clip
items.description: Weapon hits append electromagnetic damage with a base equal to 40% of the original pre-multiplier attack base.

items.name: Residual-Heat Tag
items.description: If the target is already Burning before the hit, hit damage +40% (target state).

items.name: Emergency Isolation Box
items.description: At 35% health or less before a hit, take 35% less damage after armor.

items.name: Backup Barrier Unit
items.description: On battle entry, gain a 30s shield equal to 40% maximum health, once per player per battle.

items.name: Recovery Patch
items.description: Restores 4 + 10% Mana health each second for 6s; snapshotted on application.

items.description: Move up to 2 hexes along a straight hex line. Costs 1 personal AP.
